status: Visual concept; exact pitch geometry and animated note transitions require deterministic prototype.
user_direction: Open rainbow-shaped local pitch arc, illuminate three or four nearby notes, omit rest; TonalEnergy screenshot is functional reference, not aesthetic reference.
prompt: Premium warm frosted champagne silver and off-white glass tuner. Open inverted-U local pitch arch, only G#4 A4 A#4. Soft amber light near A, fine pitch marker slightly left for -18 cents, A4 and 435.4 Hz below. Left LOWER, right HIGHER. No complete circle, smiley, twelve-note wheel or neon colors. Listening is status; small reference tone entry.
interaction: Left lower/right higher. Equal pitch steps map to equal arc-length intervals; continuous pitch marker. Shift visible neighborhood smoothly at note changes, with hysteresis for target label stability. Preserve octave through B/C. Unreliable signal dims marker and clears live readings.
